# Debian (trixie) packages beyond a default desktop install, one per line.
# Install with:
#   sed 's/#.*//' debian/packages.txt | xargs sudo apt install
#
# --- Bluetooth audio (Sony WH-1000XM5) ---------------------------------------
# Without the PipeWire Bluetooth plugin the headphones pair and connect but
# no audio profile comes up: WirePlumber logs "PipeWire's BlueZ SPA plugin is
# missing or broken". WirePlumber looks for it only at startup, so after
# installing, restart the audio stack (or log in again):
#   systemctl --user restart wireplumber pipewire pipewire-pulse
# The plugin brings LDAC (the XM5's best codec), SBC-XQ, mSBC for the mic,
# LC3, aptX and Opus. AAC is not available: Debian builds PipeWire without
# it (the fdk-aac encoder is non-free), and LDAC is better on the XM5 anyway.
pipewire-audio
libspa-0.2-bluetooth
